edges.reason: initialize assigns the token detector address into _tokenDetector

setBaycMayc writes MAYC_override
setTokenDetector is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
setReceiversData is gated by the onlyOwner modifier
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted to owner, controlling upgradeability
setTokenDetector delegates to _setTokenDetector
_setTokenDetector writes the trusted signer _tokenDetector
setReceiversData updates the nifty receiver address
setReceiversData updates the smartTokensLabs receiver address
setReceiversData updates niftyPercentage
setReceiversData updates smartTokensLabsPercentage
getRoyaltyValues multiplies amount by niftyPercentage; unchecked input could overflow
getRoyaltyValues multiplies amount by smartTokensLabsPercentage for the STL share
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount calls getRoyaltyValues to compute shares
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH calls getRoyaltyValues to compute shares
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount reads and writes _erc20payments records
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH reads and writes _ETHpayments records
convertValidateERC20Input validates the payload signature
convertValidateETHInput validates the payload signature
validateSignature recovers the signer using ecrecover/ECDSA
validateSignature requires the recovered signer to equal _tokenDetector
getERC20txData returns stored _erc20payments data
getETHtxData returns stored _ETHpayments data
withdrawERC20 validates and decodes the signed payload
withdrawERC20 accumulates the requestor share via saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount
withdrawERC20 enforces NFT ownership through validateOwner
withdrawERC20 triggers external ERC20 payout via payERC20
payERC20 performs an external safeTransfer, an attacker-controlled token could reenter
withdrawETH validates and decodes the signed payload
withdrawETH accumulates the requestor share via saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH
withdrawETH enforces NFT ownership through validateOwner
withdrawETH sends ETH via _pay, the classic reentrancy entrypoint
_pay forwards value with a low-level call, transferring control to receiver
combinedWithdrawUserRoyalty calls withdrawERC20
combinedWithdrawUserRoyalty calls withdrawETH
validateOwner resolves the NFT contract address via getContractAddress
getContractAddress may return the BAYC_override address
getContractAddress may return the MAYC_override address
validateOwner compares msg.sender against nifty, STL and the NFT owner
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmount branches on msg.sender being nifty or smartTokensLabs
saveTxDataAndGetRequestorAmountETH branches on msg.sender being nifty or smartTokensLabs
payERC20 transfers the payout directly to the untrusted msg.sender
withdrawERC20 is publicly callable by any msg.sender
withdrawETH is publicly callable by any msg.sender
Sending ETH to a contract receiver can invoke its fallback/receive and reenter
The low-level value call transfers execution control, enabling callback reentrancy
